scripts.test: bun run build && node --test dist/test/platform-stack.test.js dist/test/capacity.test.js
scripts.nag: bun run build && cdk synth --quiet -c environment=dev -c inferenceModelProfile=stub
scripts.deploy:dev: bun run preflight:dev && bun run build && cdk deploy --all --require-approval never -c environment=dev -c inferenceModelProfile=catalog && bun run verify:dev
scripts.bootstrap:local: bun run build && cdk bootstrap aws://000000000000/ap-northeast-1
scripts.deploy:local: bun run build && cdk deploy --all --require-approval never -c environment=local -c local=true -c localAuthBypass=true -c inferenceModelProfile=stub
